identity: A children's comic-strip SCRIPT (سيناريو) of the classic Abbasid anecdote of the court poet-jester Abu Dulama and Caliph al-Mahdi: he asks for a hunting dog and is progressively given a horse, a servant, a wife, a house and a date-palm farm. Structure: title line, two credit lines (سيناريو السيد حافظ / رسوم محمد حاكم), one narrator caption (كان يا ما كان...), then ~31 speech bubbles of pure unattributed dialogue. 268 tokens, 34 <NL>. Register = my doctrine's §F (children's magazine story) crossed with §E (folk tale): short turns, punchline ending. Critically it is NOT §G (Little Women): there is not a single speech verb (قال/قالت) in the document, so §G1 'weld the whole quoted utterance to its speech verb' has no anchor here and does not apply. Mean bubble is ~6 tokens; several bubbles carry 2-3 source sentences, and one bubble (@193-216) has visibly swallowed TWO speakers' turns.
law: The <NL> is the bubble, not the sentence. Inside a bubble I reconstruct the ink (LAW 0): comic lettering punctuates densely with . ؟ ! and .. so a bubble holding a declarative plus a question, or a response-particle plus a clause, is two or three segments. Four operative rules, in force order. (1) TURN-HEAD: a response particle that can stand as a whole bubble on its own — نعم / لا / صحيح / فهمت / اسمع, with or without a trailing vocative — is its own segment. The document proves this itself: نعم يا مولاي occupies a complete bubble at @166-168 and صحيح at @146, so the same string mid-bubble is the same unit. (2) DECLARATIVE + INTERROGATIVE SPLIT: the refrain هل استرحت is always a separate sentence from the gift-offer that precedes it (. then ؟ in the source). (3) LAW 1/C4 unchanged: و + a new SUBJECT or new topic NP cuts; و + same-subject VP with only a new object rides along (the فجلس وأكل خبزا وشرب ماء precedent); و joining nouns never cuts. (4) LEADING VOCATIVES ATTACH FORWARD and do not cut (LAW 4 mirror: openers go with what follows) — this is my one deliberate conservative bet in an otherwise aggressive read.
reasoning: REGISTER FIRST (LAW 6). I calibrated on line 7, @45-60, اسمع يا أبو دلامة مولانا المهدي لا يحب الطماعين من الشعراء إذا طلبت اطلب طلبا بسيطا — 16 tokens that are unmistakably three source sentences (attention-getter, statement, conditional). That single bubble proves bubbles are multi-sentence and licensed the aggressive within-bubble reading everywhere else. Cut @48 دلامة (turn-head اسمع + vocative, med) and @55 الشعراء (C1: a fronted إذا-protasis with its own apodosis is its own period, hi). // THE هل استرحت REFRAIN, the biggest systematic bet in this answer (@122, @149, @171, @201, @223, @244). The decisive evidence is @193-216, a 24-token 'bubble' that contains a speaker change: سنزوجك... وندفع لك مهر الزواج هل استرحت | لا يا مولاي.... A boundary at @203 استرحت is forced — no annotator welds the caliph's question to Abu Dulama's answer. Given that هل استرحت is a free-standing 2-token interrogative there, it is the same free-standing unit at its five other occurrences, so I cut before every هل. I acknowledge the counterweight: §G1 @436 welded قالت مارمي كم أنا سعيدة ... هل أمضيتن يوما سعيدا, and doc_50150083 @34 welded لماذا يا أبي. Both of those, however, are questions inside a quote governed by a speech verb or embedded in textbook prose. Here there is no speech verb and the ؟ is plain running-text ink, which LAW 0's corollary lists as a mark that became a ‖. I took the recall side. // TURN-HEADS. @28 سيدي (نعم يا سيدي | هذا هو قصر...), @128 مولاي (لا يا مولاي | كيف أخرج...), @154 لا (bare one-word turn, §H3 precedent <NL> أنا ‖ أبدا أنا لا أبكي ‖), @206 مولاي, @250 مولاي (نعم يا مولاي | استرحت تماما), @139 فهمت (فهمت | تحتاج إلى حصان تركبه للصيد), @113 كلب (the caliph's incredulous echo كلب | سأعطيك كلبا — also LAW 3 repetition, hi). // LAW 3 ASYNDETIC REPETITION, my cleanest site in the document: @67 المهدي in ماذا أطلب من أمير المؤمنين المهدي | ماذا أطلب منه حتى لا يغضب مني. Identical interrogative + identical verb = rhetorical repetition, exactly the أنا أقوى الأقوياء ‖ أنا عظيم العظماء ‖ shape. hi. The trailing حتى لا يغضب مني is a purpose adjunct and stays (LAW 4). Same law gives @133 الكلب (كيف أخرج للصيد ومعي الكلب | هل أسير على قدمي — two parallel questions). // WHERE I REFUSED TO CUT, and why. (a) @131 ومعي الكلب is wāw al-hāl, a subordinate circumstantial, not coordinating و; cutting would strand it. (b) @181 وأتيت به إلى منزلي and @198 وندفع لك مهر الزواج both keep the same subject and add only objects — the LAW 1 exception, decided by فاقترض بذورا وزرعها ‖ and فجلس وأكل خبزا وشرب ماء ‖. New object is NOT enough; new subject is. (c) @159 والحصان, @213-216 وزوجتي والخادم والحصان والكلب, @1 وكلب, @264 وملحقاته are all noun coordination — never cut. (d) @235 إن شاء الله is a frozen formula, not a C1 conditional period. // LAW 1 / C4 POSITIVE SITES: @232 زوجة — قد أعطيتني زوجة | والأولاد سيأتون إن شاء الله. و + a brand-new topic NP الأولاد with its own predicate سيأتون. This is C4 verbatim. hi. Then @237 الله before the asyndetic new question كيف سأطعمهم, hi. And @105 سألتني — أنت سألتني | وأنا أجبت, و + explicit new subject pronoun أنا. I rate this only 'lo': semantically it is one antithetical breath (you asked, I answered) and the source may have had nothing there, but LAW 1 was 120 of my 231 batch-1 misses and LAW 5 says the annotators cut at the FIRST available joint in a run, so I took it. @107 أجبت is much safer (hi): أنا أحتاج إلى كلب is asyndetic, independent, with its own explicit subject — a period. // @184 منزلي, the hardest single site. افترض يا مولاي أني صدت صيدا وأتيت به إلى منزلي فمن يطبخه لي غير بنت حسين العطار is 17 tokens. LAW 2 (cut before resumptive ف, ~50 batch-1 misses) fights C1 (protasis+apodosis is ONE unit). I cut, med, on the grounds that افترض is an imperative verb of supposition and not a conditional particle like لو/إن, so this ف is resumptive rather than an apodosis-ف, and the second half carries its own ؟. E3's >12-token alarm and LAW 0 broke the tie. // @19 والأوان, my most speculative call (med). كان يا ما كان في سالف العصر والأوان | شاعر عربي اسمه أبو دلامة. The storyteller formula is routinely followed by .. or ، before the subject NP, and 13 tokens exceeds this register's target. I did NOT additionally split كان يا ما كان at @15 — the kan/awan rhyme binds the formula into one breath. // THE CREDIT BLOCK. سيناريو السيد حافظ and رسوم محمد حاكم were certainly سيناريو: and رسوم: in the source, which would invite A4/J1 colon cuts. I did NOT cut them, on the strength of the one exactly-matching precedent I own: §A3, doc_5b0751f40176 @10, gold الكاتب محمد أبو قمر ‖ الرسام نبيل تاج ‖ — same register, same role-label-plus-name shape, and the gold kept each credit field whole. A3 beats A4 here because A4 was about a colon inside a book TITLE. Both lines end at <NL> anyway, so this costs nothing if right. // MY ONE DELIBERATE CONSERVATIVE BET: leading vocatives. Five sites — @39 يا سيدي الوزير, @84 and @103 يا أمير المؤمنين, @92 يا أبا دلامة, @229 يا أمير المؤمنين — where the source plausibly wrote يا أمير المؤمنين.. before the clause. I welded all five. My doctrine contains no precedent for cutting after a leading vocative, and it does contain LAW 4's mirror (openers such as على ما يبدو attach forward) and doc_50150083 @34 welding a trailing vocative. Cutting these was tempting under LAW 0 but would have been invention, not doctrine. If the gold splits them this will be a clean uniform five-site error and I will write the rule into the doctrine rather than guess it now. Note the distinction I did honour: نعم يا سيدي and لا يا مولاي DO cut, but the cut is licensed by the response particle نعم/لا, not by the vocative. // PUNCHLINE @265 وملحقاته. لم أطلب سوى كلب صيد وملحقاته | ها ها. The laugh is an interjection and §H3 says interjections were their own marks in the source; the punchline almost certainly carried ! before it. med. I declined to split ها | ها at @266 — LAW 3's literal-repetition precedent (يصغر ‖ يصغر) tempts it, but ها ها is a single onomatopoeic laugh unit, and I judged that ~35 percent, below the threshold where LAW 0's 5:1 asymmetry should override me. LAW 0 describes my bias at genuine coin-flips; it is not a licence to cut at every 1-in-3 site, and my batch-1 precision is worth keeping. // TALLY: 35 free <NL>/final boundaries plus 25 within-bubble cuts = 60 segments. Longest resulting segments are 8-10 tokens (the narrator caption, the افترض supposition, the marriage offer, the sleeping-arrangements question) and the rest are 5-7 — squarely in the §E/§F band. The 1-3 token segments are genuine dialogue turns, not over-cutting.
